review_fixes.defect: reader_tts_speak validated and stored rate, and the SAPI worker never called ISpVoice::SetRate, so every request spoke at the voice default rate
review_fixes.evidence: run 40169117214 names speak.rate.applied as the single failing speak check (29/30) on the unrepaired worker; run 40169432864 passes it with the same text at 0.5 and 2.0
review_fixes.fix: start_speak maps rate to round(log2(rate)*10) in -10..10 and calls SetRate after the voice is chosen; a failed SetRate is READER_TTS_IO with the raw HRESULT and no request

review_fixes.defect: the SAPI event buffer was declared SPEVENTEX[8] but GetEvents fills SPEVENT records, so the second and later events of a batch were read at the wrong stride (id and word parameters)
review_fixes.evidence: inspection of the ISpEventSource vtable contract; the runner's file output returns too few events per call to force a batch
review_fixes.fix: declare SPEVENT[8] and index it directly

review_fixes.defect: a stop accepted while the request was PAUSED purged the voice without resuming it; ISpVoice::Pause is a persistent state, so the next request could never reach a terminal event on a real endpoint
review_fixes.evidence: state-machine checks control.paused_stop.* and control.after_paused.* cover the accepted path; a file sink cannot show the paused engine advance, so the hang itself is not reproduced here
review_fixes.fix: track the paused state per utterance and Resume before the purge in CMD_STOP

review_fixes.defect: evidence/report.json hardcoded capabilities {pause: true, range: true} while the same report observed zero engine word positions and said so in not_exercised
review_fixes.evidence: run 40169432864 reports capabilities {pause: true, range: false} from the observed bits; strict_contract rejects a claim without positions (fixture reject.report_capability_range)
review_fixes.fix: derive the range bit from the observed engine positions; verifier rule plus rejection fixture

granted: rate mapping reaches the engine (measured PCM durations)
explicit voice token selection and completion
not_exercised: human listening judgement of the synthesised speech
playback through a physical audio device (the runner has no audio endpoint; all synthesis used the package WAV sink)

engine RANGE events: the SAPI file output on this runner reported no word position (GetEvents S_FALSE, GetStatus word fields zero), so the capability bit stays clear and report.capabilities.range is false; the UTF-16 to UTF-8 byte map is verified separately by reader_tts_windows_debug_map_utf16 (six named cases incl. surrogate pairs)
multi-event GetEvents batches: the stride repair follows the ISpEventSource vtable signature, but the runner never forced a batch, so no named check proves that path
a paused engine blocking the next request: the file sink renders faster than realtime, so only the state machine and the reachability of the next request's terminal event are asserted
Windows host wiring, reading UI and host chunking (root-owned)
pending: re-run of the range capability and the paused-engine hang on a machine with an audio endpoint
